name: QuickSplat
definition: A method for fast 3D surface reconstruction of large indoor scenes from multi-view images. It learns data-driven priors to initialize 2D Gaussian Splatting optimization and jointly predicts densification and updates per iteration, accelerating convergence and improving geometry in under-observed regions.
summary: QuickSplat is a fast 3D surface reconstruction method that replaces heuristic densification with learned networks to accelerate convergence and improve geometry in under-observed regions.
